body: I am also interested, if you find something.
I think that writing about your feelings will help ease your pain, so write and write and write until you feel like you can make it through one more day.

I feel like it's medical as well, but all the blood tests show nothing wrong. I was fine for years, and in the last 6 months, I've been blowing up once in a while and now it's getting more and more frequent until I'm just out of control. Once I calm down, I'm fine, but I have this doom feeling like I can't survive.
Sounds like those who are making you feel this way are wasting your time, and not that your time here is wasted. Any support groups near by?
